card.line: Nain was a town in Galilee, near the plain of Esdraelon, where Jesus raised a widow's only son from the dead at the town gate.

moments.title: Jesus meets a funeral
moments.text: As Jesus came near the town gate with His disciples and a large crowd, a dead man was being carried out, the only son of a widow. When the Lord saw her, He had compassion and told her, "Do not weep."

moments.title: The dead son lives again
moments.text: Jesus touched the coffin and told the young man to get up. The dead man sat up and began to speak, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.

moments.title: The people praise God
moments.text: Awe swept over everyone, and they glorified God, saying a great prophet had appeared and that God had visited His people. The news spread through Judea and the surrounding region.
